concept: A men's grooming house and barbershop; services and booking.
palette: dark green, leather brown, brass, white

shots.title: Hero still life
shots.prompt: Luxury beauty still life of a beard oil bottle in amber glass with a brass cap with sidr leaves and oud chips, on a sculpted stone plinth, soft directional light and long shadows, negative space on one side for a headline. Original packaging, no text on it. Overall look: moody barbershop photography, tungsten light, 35mm; colour palette of dark green, leather brown, brass, white. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
